request.prompt_preview: CASE FILE Question: Sites S-TUN-001 and S-TUN-002 in Tunis lost all service for a few hours yesterday evening. What happened? Now: 2026-09-03 09:00 (Thursday, Africa/Tunis). Data after this time does

response.text: The evidence clearly shows that a transport failure (fiber cut) on shared link LNK-TUN-01-A caused a total service outage on sites S-TUN-001 and S-TUN-002 from 18:00 to 22:00 on 2026-09-02 (T1, T4). The timing matches the critical `LINK_LOS` alarm (ALM-000001) and subsequent `SITE_DOWN` alarms (T4), with no competing changes, maintenance windows, or external events found (T7, T8). The incident fully resolved at 22:00 when the link cleared.
